simple.meaning: אֵלֶם (ʼêlem) is a Hebrew word meaning “silence (i.e. mute justice).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: אֵלֶם (H482) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Psalms 56:1, with occurrences in Psalms.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אֵלֶם (H482) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in אֵלֶם (H482) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: אֵלֶם (ʼêlem) / H482 is traced through Psalms 56:1, Psalms 58:2 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
